title: Cultural Do's and Don'ts for Backpackers
description: Nghi thức văn hóa quốc tế: tip tiền, trang phục đền chùa và tôn trọng phong tục địa phương.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: nghi thức, phép lịch sự xã hội
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Understanding local cultural etiquette prevents accidental offense.
Touching someone's head is considered a sacred cultural taboo in Southeast Asia.
Embrace local hospitality with humble gratitude and gracious manners.

transcript.en: Hey everybody, Mark from Wolters World teaching you how to travel respectfully.
